name: D1-mini
description: WEMOS/LOLIN D1 mini (ESP8266), 2x8 pins, rows 0.9" apart
source: https://www.wemos.cc/en/latest/d1/d1_mini_3.1.0.html — pin table and top photo; schematic https://www.wemos.cc/en/latest/_static/files/sch_d1_mini_v3.0.0.pdf (P1 pins 1-16); row distance 22.86 mm from https://www.wemos.cc/en/latest/_static/files/dim_d1_mini_v4.0.0.pdf
notes: D0 = GPIO16, D1 = GPIO5, D2 = GPIO4, D3 = GPIO0, D4 = GPIO2, D5 = GPIO14, D6 = GPIO12, D7 = GPIO13, D8 = GPIO15. Version 4 prints GPIO numbers instead and calls 5V 'VBUS' (wired straight to USB). The row distance comes from the V4 drawing; no v3 drawing exists. Clones and v1/v2 not checked.
